data.indexFullNameCn: 中证全指自由现金流指数
data.indexFullNameEn: CSI All Share Free Cash Flow Index
data.indexCnDesc: 中证全指自由现金流指数选取100只自由现金流率较高的上市公司证券作为指数样本，以反映现金流创造能力较强的上市公司证券的整体表现。
data.indexEnDesc: The CSI All Share Free Cash Flow Index selects 100 securities with high free cash flow yield as constituents. The index is to reflect the overall performance of companies with strong cash flow generation capabilities.
